tagline: Leading Chinese Smart Electric Vehicle Manufacturer with Extended Range Technology
hero_kpi_rationale: The cumulative number of vehicles delivered demonstrates Li Auto's commercial traction and production capacity in the highly competitive Chinese smart electric vehicle market, reaching 1.5 million units in December 2025.

kpis.name: Cumulative Vehicle Deliveries
kpis.explanation: Total number of vehicles delivered by the company since the start of its operations.
kpis.description: This KPI represents Li Auto's market adoption and penetration, a key indicator of its commercial performance and leadership position in the Chinese electric vehicle market.
kpis.signal: Reached the milestone of 1.5 million deliveries, demonstrating significant growth in the smart EV market in China.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting the cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Indicates the core profitability of vehicle manufacturing and sales operations, including direct production, materials, and logistics costs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses, including R&D and general and administrative costs.
kpis.description: Measures the company's overall efficiency in generating profits from its core activities of electric vehicle design, manufacturing, and sales.

kpis.name: R&D Investments as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpis.description: Indicates the company's commitment to technological innovation and the development of new electric vehicle models and related technologies.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (factories and equipment)
kpis.explanation: Spending dedicated to the acquisition or improvement of long-term physical assets, such as production plants and equipment.
kpis.description: Reflects investments in expanding production capacity and enhancing manufacturing infrastructure, essential to support future growth.

kpis.name: Total Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company across all operational and administrative departments.
kpis.description: An indicator of the organization's size and its human resource capacity to support manufacturing, R&D, and commercial expansion.

ai_positioning.summary: The provided text contains no information on Li Auto Inc.'s positioning regarding artificial intelligence. The analyzed documents focus on automotive operations, production costs, and tax governance structure.
